The safe mode that `promptfoo` version 0.125.0 added to `eval` turns off inline JavaScript assertions and shared transforms. Specifically, it rejects string-based JavaScript assertions and inline expressions that are handled by the shared transform helper. This mode can be activated using the command `promptfoo eval --safe-mode` or by setting the environment variable `PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true`. This configuration ensures that JavaScript function values passed through the Node API are still supported, but rejected assertions and transforms are handled with errors.

Relevant quotes:
- "Reject inline JavaScript assertions and shared transforms." [1] promptfoo/site/docs/usage/command-line.md (lines 125-125)
- "Use `promptfoo eval --safe-mode` or `PROMPTFOO_SAFE_MODE=true` to reject string-based JavaScript assertions and inline expressions handled by the shared transform helper." [2] promptfoo/site/docs/configuration/expected-outputs/javascript.md (lines 11-64)
